query: What events are covered under Section I for loss or damage to the insured vehicle?

without_cache.answer:
Under Section I, the company will indemnify the insured against loss or damage to the insured vehicle and/or its accessories whilst thereon by the following events:

* Fire, explosion, self-ignition, or lightning [Document 3, Page 1, Section I. LOSS OF OR DAMAGE TO THE VEHICLE INSURED]
* Burglary, housebreaking, or theft [Document 3, Page 1, Section I. LOSS OF OR DAMAGE TO THE VEHICLE INSURED]
* Riot and strike [Document 3, Page 1, Section I. LOSS OF OR DAMAGE TO THE VEHICLE INSURED]
* Earthquake (fire and shock damage) [Document 3, Page 1, Section I. LOSS OF OR DAMAGE TO THE VEHICLE INSURED]
* Flood, typhoon, hurricane, storm, tempest, inundation, cyclone, hailstorm, frost [Document 3, Page 1, Section I. LOSS OF OR DAMAGE TO THE VEHICLE INSURED]
* Accidental external means [Document 3, Page 1, Section I. LOSS OF OR DAMAGE TO THE VEHICLE INSURED]
* Malicious act [Document 3, Page 1, Section I. LOSS OF OR DAMAGE TO THE VEHICLE INSURED]
* Terrorist activity [Document 3, Page 1, Section I. LOSS OF OR DAMAGE TO THE VEHICLE INSURED]
* Transit by road, rail, inland-waterway, lift, elevator, or air [Document 3, Page 1, Section I. LOSS OF OR DAMAGE TO THE VEHICLE INSURED]
* Landslide or rockslide [Document 3, Page 1, Section I. LOSS OF OR DAMAGE TO THE VEHICLE INSURED]
